scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test-standard: pnpm run validate:failure-gate && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run validate:clerk-skill && node --test scripts/validate-api-codegen.test.mjs && node --test scripts/check-failure-gate.test.mjs scripts/check-regression-guard.test.mjs && node --test scripts/workspace-skill.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:port && node --experimental-strip-types --test artifacts/html-port-studio/src/pages/home.test.ts artifacts/html-port-studio/src/lib/source-adapters.test.ts artifacts/html-port-studio/src/lib/source-editor.test.ts && pnpm --filter @workspace/html-port-studio run test:browser
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
